source: certificate-transparency logs (CT-log mirror; the reproducible public collector is scripts/enumerate_certs.py against crt.sh)
collection_note: crt.sh returned persistent HTTP 5xx during collection, so a certificate-transparency log mirror was queried instead. The mirror's ingestion window is roughly 2026-forward, which captures every currently-valid certificate (90-day LE/GTS certificates auto-renew, so a co-managed pair still shares a live certificate) but not long-expired ones.
